The '''Muskeg Anarchist Camp''' was a ruined building located in the [[Lasay Swamp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the building was used as a camp by the [[Muskegs]], a fanatical and violent sect of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the camp in order to retrieve a valuable Gungan artifact stolen by [[Flossin Noz]], a Muskeg zealot chief. Several Muskeg anarchists were killed during the assault.<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" />
